name: Erovisa Never Clear
author: AAidalol
description: One of if not the most infamous level on the AALL, being made to be top one and for Erovisa to never clear. Also a robbed top one, since the levels above it at the time are now considered NLW today. Also Aida's worst experience verifying an AALL level to this day. At the time of writing this, Erovisa has yet to clear. Hardest Part is 3-26.
